entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-07-13
entry.content:
Azure.Template_1.0.3-beta.6555573

1.0.3-beta.6555573 (2026-07-13)

Features Added

  • Added WidgetAnalyticsClientSettings to support creating a WidgetAnalyticsClient from IConfiguration, including configuration-based credential resolution and dependency injection registration.

Azure.ResourceManager.RecoveryServices_1.3.0

1.3.0 (2026-07-10)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-05-01.
  • Added ImmutabilitySettings property to RecoveryServicesSecuritySettings for full immutability configuration access.
  • Added ImmutabilityConfiguration and ImmutabilityType models for vault immutability settings.
  • Added RecoveryServicesCostGranularityLevel enum for cost management granularity settings.
  • Added CostManagementGranularityLevel property to RecoveryServicesVaultProperties.

Azure.Provisioning.ServiceFabric_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-07-10)

Features Added

  • Initial preview of Azure.Provisioning.ServiceFabric.
